'''Rakim''' is a soldier in [[Lan]]'s army during the [[Aiel War]]. 

== Appearance ==
He is grizzled. He has a hoarse voice due to receiving an [[Aiel]] arrow in the throat. He now has a ragged scar. He has tilted eyes.

== History ==
He is a [[Saldaean]] who considers himself lucky because he once cheated death. Lan thinks he is foolish for taking too many chances. He brings a messenger to Lan from Lord [[Emares]]. He then travels with Lan to [[Kinslayer's Dagger]], in pursuit of the retreating Aiel.

More than twenty years later, Rakim, [[Andere]] and [[Nazar Kurenin]] all meet up with Lan and [[Bulen]] along the [[Plain of Lances]]. They travel in front of Lan until he finally accepts them into his company.
Rakim brings [[Weilin Aldragoran]] and his company into Lan's camp, much to Lan's displeasure.
